name: Simeon Yetarian
description: सिमियन येटेरियन: 'प्रीमियम डीलक्स मोटरस्पोर्ट' लक्जरी कार शोरूम का धोखेबाज कार डीलर।
features: Repossession assignments and export deliveries
High-priority vehicle drop-offs paid in cash at the docks
Classic contact missions & Premium Deluxe Repo Work

name: Lester Crest
description: लेस्टर क्रेस्ट: पूरे सैन एंड्रियास में बड़ी डकैतियों और स्टॉक मार्केट हेरफेर की योजना बनाने वाला मास्टरमाइंड।
features: Heist planning for Paleto Score, The Big Score, and Diamond Casino Heist
Phone service to remove wanted levels
Cyber intelligence hub for The FIB Files

name: Lamar Davis
description: लामार डेविस: फ्रैंकलिन का बचपन का दोस्त, फैमिलीज गैंग का चंचल, बातूनी और हास्यप्रद गैंगस्टर।
features: Lowriders missions for Benny's Original Motor Works
Mugger phone service to harass other players
Cultivation and delivery jobs for LD Organics
income: Neighborhood contracts and LD Organics payouts

name: Martin Madrazo
description: मार्टिन माद्राज़ो: ला फुएंते ब्लैंका फार्म का संचालन करने वाले माद्राज़ो कार्टेल का क्रूर ड्रग लॉर्ड।
features: Witness elimination hit contracts for the Madrazo Cartel
Special dispatch assassinations
Access to the Cayo Perico Heist via his son Miguel Madrazo

name: Gerald
description: जेराल्ड: स्ट्रॉबेरी में फैमिलीज गिरोह का ड्रग डीलर। प्रतिद्वंद्वी गिरोहों पर हमला करने के मिशन देता है।
features: Classic co-op contact missions (Pier Pressure, Violent Duct, Death Metal)
Narrative finale missions: Gerald's Last Play
Central drop-off spot for contraband stashes in Strawberry
income: Stash payouts and gang interception cash

name: Trevor Philips
description: ट्रेवर फिलिप्स: पूर्व सैन्य पायलट; गुस्से, हिंसा और अराजकता से भरे टीपी एंटरप्राइजेज का संस्थापक।
features: Hub of Trevor Philips Enterprises on Zancudo Avenue
Mission base for Series A Funding and Humane Labs Heist
Rural airstrip and helicopter landing pad nearby
income: Regional smuggling from Trevor Philips Enterprises

name: Ron Jakowski
description: ट्रेवर का वफादार और पागल साथी। साजिश सिद्धांत रेडियो होस्ट और हैंगर हवाई तस्करी का प्रबंधक।
features: Direct contact for airborne cargo theft and hangar operations
Opening liaison for the Los Santos Drug Wars storyline
Classic aviation contact missions
income: Commissions on air cargo contraband shipments

name: Dax
description: Psychedelic den of the Fooliganz situated inside the Mirror Park rail depot. Acquire the MTL Brickade 6x6, customize the mobile Acid Lab, and run Fooligan jobs.
features: Installation and upgrade of the mobile Acid Lab in the MTL Brickade 6x6
Weapon workbench and dedicated service workshop
Fooligan jobs to boost acid production speed and profitability
income: Direct chemical product sales and Fooligan rewards

name: Franklin Clinton
description: फ्रैंकलिन क्लिंटन: लॉस सैंटोस में मशहूर हस्तियों के संकट को सुलझाने वाली 'एफ. क्लिंटन एंड पार्टनर' वीआईपी एजेंसी के पार्टनर।
features: Dr. Dre VIP Contract with cinematic story missions
Payphone assassination hits with assassination bonuses ($85,000)
Vehicle recovery and private security contracts
income: VIP contract payouts and security commissions

name: Tony Prince
description: Liberty City's iconic 'Gay Tony', king of nightlife and managing partner of your Los Santos nightclub. Supervises popularity, DJ residencies, and passive warehouse accrual.
features: Full club popularity management and daily safe revenue ($50,000)
Underground illicit storage hub with assigned logistics technicians
Access to The Music Locker underground dance club beneath the Casino
income: Daily club safe revenue and warehouse goods shipments

name: Agatha Baker
description: General Manager of The Diamond Casino & Resort. Assigns VIP customer conflict jobs, defense against the hostile Dungan cartel takeover, and casino story missions.
features: Diamond Casino operations and narrative missions
Phone desk service to request limousines and daily complimentary chips
Cash bonuses, casino chips, and luxury penthouse access
income: Casino service awards and VIP chip payouts

name: Agent 14
description: Undercover handler with the government's IAA agency. Coordinates underground military gunrunning manufacturing in Bunkers and tactical operations for the Doomsday Heist.
features: Supervision of military arms manufacturing and research projects in Bunkers
Tactical coordination of all three Doomsday Heist acts
Covert government contact with orbital cannon support
income: High-value weapon shipment sales from the Bunker
